name: C12.F12: the pre-map grant clause dropped from INV-SCALE-5
find: If the initial configure grants protocol fullscreen on output O (C12.F6), ρ_pred = max(`scale_O`, F-SCALE-1 over the current views of the other outputs whose view intersects the placed window-geometry rect, or the anchor point when its size is 0×0). The grant's own presentation contributes `scale_O` at zoom 1; O's current view does not count.
